rulings.model: Counting more than 6 whole months ignores the exception for a person born or died in 2025. The text reads "the person is considered to have lived with you for more than half of 2025 if your home was this person's home for more than half the time the person was alive in 2025." The same applies to adoption or foster placement in 2025.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: second reading right; data changed under BUG-0014. The months question now tells the filer to enter 12 for a person born, died, adopted or placed in 2025 whose home was the filer's for more than half the time alive or with them (i1040gi p. 14, Exception to time lived with you); the test itself is unchanged.
